top.line: Person Graph: keys, two-way links, kinds, groups, claims and personas as one picture, with mock-ups and a simulation.

in-short.line: One picture, kinds of link, groups, through Claude, a simulation, bad actors at scale.

one.line: Keys in repositories, two-way links, countersigned claims, personas and the re-identification check are one thing.

kinds.line: Real, know, worked with, vouch to hire, operates: each signed, each counted only both ways.

groups.line: Artists, founders, educators, professionals, agents as centres of gravity for navigation.

claude.line: Each person's Claude makes keys, signs links, publishes and walks the graph; then it takes on a life of its own.

simulation.line: 150 people, 40 fakes: counting links puts 34 fakes in the top 40, two-way trust none; it weakens as more are fooled.

bad-actors.line: A fake cluster has a shape an agent can see; nobody banned; the fooled are asked; detection spread out.

site.line: Profiles, check a link, groups, explore; free for people, paid by those who countersign and verify.

limits.line: Fictional mock-ups and a small simulation; a proposal on pieces that exist.

sources.line: My thinking on 21 November 2026 and a simulation run in the writer's session.
